question.text: SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 Chapter IX-A applies to:

answer.text: A For Profit Social Enterprise whose designated securities are listed on the applicable stock exchange segment, and a Not for Profit Organization registered on the Social Stock Exchange
Any company with equity shares listed on a recognised stock exchange
Only private limited companies seeking preferential allotment
Only foreign portfolio investors investing through the Social Stock Exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook treats Chapter IX-A of LODR as the chapter that sets out disclosure requirements for For Profit Social Enterprises whose designated securities are listed on the applicable stock exchange segment and for Not for Profit Organizations registered on the Social Stock Exchange. The Trap: The generic LODR scope (option B) is broader than Chapter IX-A's specific application. Preferential allotment sits in ICDR rather than LODR, and foreign portfolio investors are not the subject of Chapter IX-A. Note: Chapter IX-A layers Social Enterprise / Social Stock Exchange disclosures on top of the general LODR framework, so SE filings often need to be read alongside the corresponding ICDR provisions.
